service.description: The header and metadata of the PMTiles archive at a resource location (location#versionName for a version), read by range (the 127-byte header, then the metadata where it says) and checked: version 3, the zoom range, the bounds, every section within the file and the root directory within its first 16 KiB, tiles of vector (mvt) or image type, directories gzipped or not compressed, metadata that is a JSON object (naming its vector layers for vector tiles). found false when nothing is there; each reason a map cannot draw it in problems, and valid true only when there is none. Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so it is MAPS_ADMIN's and not remote: register#ArchiveLayer and the readiness checks call it, after their own check of the caller (Configuration's update by the caller's own grant, ADMIN_OVERVIEW_VIEW).

parameter.name: tag
parameter.description: The strong tag the storage reads it with; empty for a file on disk

parameter.name: header

service.description: The header of a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (P4c; moqui-lib geo/tiff.rs) at a resource location (location#versionName for a version), read by range, or its first bytes (bytes, the file's size) a provider's COG answered a range with: the TIFF or BigTIFF header and its image directories (at most 64, each of at most 1024 entries, at most 1 MiB read past the first 64 KiB, every offset and count checked against the size; a loop refused), never a tile. A map draws it when it is tiled (a multiple of 16, at most 4096), of a compression a browser decodes, of 8, 16, 32 or 64-bit samples, georeferenced without rotation, in an EPSG CRS that is WGS84, Web Mercator or a registered projection (MapProjection), with overviews when it is larger than 2048 pixels; each reason it cannot in problems. Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so it is MAPS_ADMIN's and not remote, as read#ArchiveHeader is: register#ArchiveLayer calls it after its own check of the caller.

parameter.name: bytes
parameter.description: The file's first bytes, instead of a location

parameter.name: size
parameter.description: The file's size with bytes (a Content-Range's total)

parameter.name: cog

service.description: Whether the server reads a map projection's PROJ.4 definition (P4c; moqui-lib geo/proj.rs): its methods (geographic, Mercator, transverse Mercator and UTM, Lambert conformal conic and azimuthal equal-area, Albers, polar stereographic) with a datum of WGS84, NAD83 or a +towgs84 shift; readable false with the reason otherwise (a grid, another method, an ellipsoid with no shift). A pure function of its text: store#Projection calls it.

A geographic file read as a map overlay (plans/Maps.md §4.1, §8; moqui-lib geo/overlay.rs and its readers): GeoJSON, TopoJSON, EsriJSON, GPX, KML, GML, WKT, WKB, delimited text with a WKT, WKB or latitude and longitude column, or a zipped shapefile, at a resource location (read as the framework) or given as text or bytes, at most maxBytes, at most maxFeatures features, WGS84 or a declared EPSG:3857 (a GeoJSON or TopoJSON crs, an EsriJSON spatialReference, a GML srsName, an EWKT or EWKB SRID, a shapefile's .prj; converted; any other CRS refused), each feature's geometry checked by itself (one that is not sane is left out, counted and named in notes), labels and descriptions made plain text, and no KML network link, image overlay, style, icon or other reference followed (each counted in notes). Answers a sanitized GeoJSON FeatureCollection (geojson, unless summaryOnly) with featureCount, rejectedCount, bounds and crs; a file that cannot be an overlay is valid false with reasonCode (FORMAT_UNKNOWN, NOT_FOUND, NOT_READ, NOT_TEXT, TOO_LARGE, NOT_PARSED, NOT_FORMAT, CRS_UNSUPPORTED, TOO_MANY_FEATURES, NO_FEATURES) and reason. Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so no group is granted it: the overlay services (MapOverlays.js) call it after their own check of the caller's drive access.

parameter.name: bytes
parameter.description: The file's bytes (an upload of a binary format: WKB, a zipped shapefile)

parameter.name: format
parameter.description: An MLF_ enum ID of a format read (MLF_GEOJSON, MLF_TOPOJSON, MLF_ESRIJSON, MLF_GPX, MLF_KML, MLF_GML, MLF_WKT, MLF_WKB, MLF_CSV, MLF_SHAPEFILE); else by fileName's extension

parameter.name: transform
parameter.description: What converting crs to WGS84 did (P4c: a registered projection's method, ellipsoid and datum shift with its accuracy); empty for WGS84

service.description: An overlay file (any format convert#Overlay reads) too large to draw whole cut into vector tiles (plans/Maps.md §7; moqui-lib geo/tiles.rs over geo/simplify.rs and geo/mvt.rs, moqui-tools maps_simplify.rs): read and sanitized as convert#Overlay reads it but with up to maxFeatures (250,000) features, projected to Web Mercator, and for each zoom from 0 simplified (Douglas–Peucker to half a pixel), clipped to each tile with a small buffer, points thinned to one a pixel, written as one MVT layer overlay with each feature's label and description, until a zoom keeps everything (from zoom 12), maxZoom (14), or before a zoom that would pass maxTiles (50,000) or maxArchiveBytes (64 MiB); answered as a PMTiles archive (bytes; tiles and directories gzipped). Each zoom made is written to overlayId's row as tilesProgress (in its own transaction) and its tilesCancel read, so a cancel stops it (CANCELLED, cancelled true). Refusals: the overlay reader's reasons, NOT_FOUND, NOT_READ, NOT_TEXT, TOO_LARGE_TO_TILE (zoom 0 alone passes the limits), NO_TILES. Writes nothing but the progress. It reads whatever location it is given, so no group is granted it: build#OverlayTiles calls it after its own check.

The MapOverlayTiles ServiceJob's run (store#Overlay with generalize starts it, as the user): the user's own overlay overlayId, pending or running, simplified into vector tiles (generalize#Overlay) and the archive written beside its file in its drive as "name.tiles.pmtiles" (FileServices upload#Resource, replacing an earlier one: the drive's own write check, quota and versions), its version and content address recorded on the row (tilesStatus ready, tilesPath, tilesRevision, tilesTag, tilesSize, tilesMaxZoom), so LocalMap's tile transition draws it with the file's own access. A file no longer readable, a refusal, a write refused, an archive the drive keeps in git outside LFS and a cancel end it failed or cancelled with tilesNote, written in a transaction of its own; the overlay removed or its run ended meanwhile writes nothing. An earlier archive is replaced only when it is this overlay's own (its tilesPath); another file of that name is kept and the new one named "name (2)". Another user's overlay changes nothing. Out: the row's label, tilesStatus and reason, for the job's notification.

Stop the simplifying of one of the signed-in user's overlays (tilesStatus pending or running): its run stops within a second (between tiles) and ends cancelled, the overlay left as it was; a run that ended without saying so (its ServiceJobRun gone or ended, or older than the job's transaction) is ended at once. Another user's overlay, one not there and one not being simplified are RECORD_UNAVAILABLE. MAPS_APP_SERVICES, as the other overlay services.

The simplifying of the signed-in user's own overlays overlayIds (at most 100; another user's is left out): each one's tilesStatus and tilesProgress, for Browse's poll while a run goes on. Changes nothing. MAPS_APP_SERVICES, as the other overlay services.

Register the archive of a PMTiles layer (format MLF_PMTILES_VECTOR or MLF_PMTILES_RASTER), at resourceLocation (the layer's own when empty), as the revision maps read. On storage that keeps versions (git://, dbresource://) the current version is recorded (sourceVersionName), so a later write does not change what a map reads until the layer is registered again; the content address of that version is the revision (sourceRevision, sourceTag, sourceSize, sourceAddressKind: an LFS object's oid, a content blob's or a small file's SHA-256). A file on disk has none: its SHA-256 is read once, with its modification time. Refused, the layer unchanged: a caller who may not change Maps › Configuration (PERMISSION_DENIED); a layer that is not a PMTiles one (FORMAT_NOT_ARCHIVE); a location with # or ?, or a folder (LOCATION_INVALID); nothing there (SOURCE_GONE); storage not known to read by range (STORAGE_NOT_RANGED: an archive is kept on disk, in dbresource:// or in git); in a git repository, a file that is not a Git LFS object (NOT_LFS: any other git object is read whole for every request); a header a map cannot draw (ARCHIVE_INVALID, with each of problems); tiles not of the layer's format (TILE_TYPE_MISMATCH). Records the drive the location is under (driveId), whose access a viewer needs too, the archive's zoom range and bounds, its attribution and version when the layer has none, and enables the layer. notes: what the archive's size meets (the upload limit, an LFS object's, its drive's quota). A new revision is replaced (replaced true): a map drawing the old one is refused it (409) and loads its configuration again. One action registers every layer drawn from the archive: layerId, those of alsoLayerIds and every other PMTiles layer of its format that already names the location, the header read once (one that is not of the archive's format refuses the whole action, nothing changed). layerId and alsoLayerIds are enabled; a layer that only named the location keeps its enabled or disabled state.
A Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF layer (MLF_COG, P4c) is registered the same way from a resource location, its header read by read#CogHeader instead (COG_INVALID with each of problems), and records its CRS (crs), bounds and what its header holds (rasterJson: bands, sample type, no-data, statistics and its default band settings). A COG layer with no location and a sourceUrl of its provider (enabled, tested, the URL on its own origin, outside requests on) is read from there: one range of its first 64 KiB with no credentials, no redirect and no internal address unless the provider is allowed the private network, which must answer 206 (NO_RANGES otherwise) and allow the page's origin by CORS (NO_CORS: a browser reads it itself); nothing is pinned, so a later change of the file is the provider's.

parameter.name: alsoLayerIds
parameter.description: Other PMTiles layers of the same format to point at the same archive and register with it (the light and dark styles of one Protomaps extract); every other layer that already names the location is registered with it too

parameter.name: layerIds
parameter.description: Every layer registered: layerId first, then the others pointed at the same archive

service.description: One asset of a proxied map provider (proxyRequests Y; plans/Maps.md §4.2) for the LocalMap providerProxy transition: its style, a TileJSON, a tile or a sprite at a path a rule its last passing test recorded matches (proxyPaths: an exact document path, a sprite with its suffixes, a tile template), asked of the provider's origin with that rule's query (never the browser's, but for an OGC rule, wms, wmts or wfs, the parameters its kind's requests carry, each checked against the recorded capabilities, MapOgc.js proxyQuery: QUERY_NOT_ALLOWED, 400, otherwise) and its key added here, never returned; within its requestsPerSecond and requestsPerDay (RATE_LIMITED, DAILY_LIMIT: 429). For a caller who may be offered one of its layers (enabled, its viewPermission held, the basemap or a layer of an enabled profile whose viewPermission they hold), while outside requests are on (EXTERNAL_REQUESTS_OFF, 403) and the provider enabled, proxied and tested as it is (PROVIDER_MISSING, PROVIDER_UNTESTED, 404); another path is PATH_NOT_ALLOWED (404). One GET, no redirect, ten seconds, at most 4 MiB, no internal address unless the provider is allowed the private network, of a style, TileJSON, sprite or tile type only (PROVIDER_FAILED, TYPE_REFUSED: 502). A style or TileJSON comes back rewritten (text) with each URL the proxy's and the key out of it (URL_NOT_PROVIDERS, 502, for a URL of another origin); anything else as its bytes. cacheControl is always private: no-store for a cachePolicy of none, else its cacheSeconds or the answer's own max-age, at most a day. Every signed-in user may call it (MAPS_DIALOG): it checks the caller itself.

parameter.name: pathSegments
parameter.description: The path on the provider's origin, its segments decoded

parameter.name: queryString
parameter.description: The query the browser sent (the style's own, never the key)

service.description: Whether the current user may read a registered archive layer at a revision now, for the map-source transition on every request (GET, HEAD, each range), writing nothing (no ResourceRecent): the layer enabled, PMTiles and registered (SOURCE_MISSING, SOURCE_NOT_REGISTERED: 404), its viewPermission held (one not held is SOURCE_MISSING), its provider enabled (PROVIDER_DISABLED), and at least view on its drive at its path (FileServices get#DriveAccess: a member, or a share of the file or a folder above it; SOURCE_NOT_PERMITTED, 403, so a revoked share or a removed member is refused at the next request). A revision that is not the registered one (REVISION_CHANGED) and a file on disk changed since it was registered (SOURCE_CHANGED) are 409, so the map loads its configuration again. When ok: the location to send (location#versionName on storage that keeps versions) with the registered tag and size, for ec.web.sendPinnedResourceResponse. Every signed-in user may call it (MAPS_DIALOG): it checks the layer and the drive itself.

One Z/X/Y tile of a registered PMTiles archive (plans/Maps.md §5: a client with no PMTiles reader) for the LocalMap tile transition, on every request, writing nothing: layerId a registered layer, checked as get#SourceAccess checks it (SOURCE_MISSING, SOURCE_NOT_REGISTERED, PROVIDER_DISABLED 404; SOURCE_NOT_PERMITTED 403; REVISION_CHANGED, SOURCE_CHANGED 409), or overlay:ID, a user's overlay generalized on the server (build#OverlayTiles), read only by a reader of its file in its drive now (OVERLAY_MISSING 404; another revision 409). Then read#ArchiveTile reads the tile by range. status 200 with the tile's bytes, its content type and contentEncoding gzip when the archive's tiles are gzipped and the client takes it (else decompressed), 204 for no tile of a vector archive (an empty tile), 304 for an ifNoneMatch naming its ETag, 404 for no tile of an image archive or one not read (TILE_MISSING). etag is strong (the registered tag, the tile ID, the encoding); cacheControl private for resource-facade@pinned-max-age, immutable (the revision is in the URL). Every signed-in user may call it (MAPS_DIALOG): it checks the layer or the overlay and the access itself.

parameter.name: y
parameter.description: May end in the tile's extension (.mvt, .pbf, .png)

service.description: Tile z/x/y of the PMTiles archive at location (location#versionName on storage that keeps versions), registered as tag of size bytes (moqui-tools maps_tiles.rs over moqui-lib pmtiles.rs): the header, the root and the leaf directories the lookup goes through (run lengths included) and the tile, each read by range as the framework; the header and the decoded directories kept by the tag, within a bound (256 directories, about two million entries). status 200 (bytes, contentType, contentEncoding gzip or empty, etag), 204 (no tile of a vector archive), 304 (ifNoneMatch names its etag), 404 (no tile of an image archive, a tile not read, with reason), 409 (content that is no longer that tag and size); cacheControl. Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so no group is granted it and it is not remote: get#ArchiveTile calls it after its check of the caller.

What cutting a region (west, south, east, north in WGS84 degrees, west east of east across the antimeridian) at zooms minZoom to maxZoom from the PMTiles archive at location (pinned as tag of size bytes, a file on disk by modifiedMillis too) would make, for an offline map package (plans/Maps-Offline.md §2.2; moqui-tools maps_extract.rs): the tiles found through its directories (the header and directories read by range and kept by the tag, as read#ArchiveTile keeps them; no tile is read), their distinct contents and bytes, and the archive's size near enough (bytes), with the zooms of the request the archive has. Refused (reasonCode, reason): BBOX_INVALID, ZOOMS_INVALID, SOURCE_MISSING, SOURCE_GONE, SOURCE_CHANGED (no longer that tag and size), NO_ZOOMS, TOO_MANY_TILES (the box covers more than maxTiles tiles, at most 4,000,000, counted before anything is read), TOO_LARGE (bytes past maxBytes), NOT_READ (logged). Writes nothing. It reads whatever location it is given, so no group is granted it and it is not remote: MapPackages.js calls it after its check of the owner.

The region and zooms of estimate#PackageExtract cut from the archive at location into a new PMTiles archive at target (a .pmtiles location under runtime://tmp/map-packages/, TARGET_INVALID otherwise), for an offline map package (moqui-tools maps_extract.rs over moqui-lib pmtiles.rs ArchiveWriter): the tiles of the box for each zoom, sorted by tile ID, found through the directories and read by range in batches by offset (neighbouring tiles one read), each handed as stored to the streaming writer, which writes the tile data to a part file and keeps only the directory entries; a content the source shares between tiles is read and stored once; the source's metadata JSON is copied whole, the directories gzipped. The archive's tag and size are checked when the cut starts and again when it ends (reopened, a file on disk by its modification time too): an archive replaced meanwhile is SOURCE_CHANGED and nothing is kept. With packageId its progress, from progressFrom to progressTo percent, is written to that MapPackage's row in a transaction of its own between batches (at most once a second), and the row's cancelRequested read then (CANCELLED, cancelled true). Out: size, sha256 (hex), tileCount, contentCount, minZoom, maxZoom, reads; refused as the estimate is, and NO_TILES. A refused or failed cut leaves no file. It reads whatever location it is given, so no group is granted it and it is not remote: MapPackages.js calls it in the MapPackageBuild job after its check of the owner.

The PMTiles layers for Maps › Configuration › Archives, for a caller who may open Configuration (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise): each with its location, registered revision, version, size, zoom range, drive, the profiles whose basemap it is, its state now (ready; NOT_REGISTERED; NEWER_REVISION, a later revision stored but not registered; SOURCE_CHANGED, SOURCE_GONE, NOT_LFS, STORAGE_NOT_RANGED) and what its size meets; and the limits (max-upload, git-server@lfs-max-object-size and max-object-size, resource-facade@pinned-max-age). Changes nothing.

The maps.archives readiness provider (data/AdminConfigurationData.xml), changing nothing, for a caller with ADMIN_OVERVIEW_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise): each PMTiles layer with a location, enabled or registered, as find#ArchiveLayers states it (NOT_REGISTERED and NEWER_REVISION warnings; NOT_LFS, a git archive that is not a Git LFS object, refused by name, SOURCE_CHANGED, SOURCE_GONE and STORAGE_NOT_RANGED failed); NO_ARCHIVES when there is none.
